contract.title: D1/D2 independent cold-start review
contract.goal: Review the read-only semantics of the combined baseline at commit 2bf3858. Verify D1 distance-dependent MCS rates and D2 dynamic topology rematching against the repository contracts, with emphasis on packet conservation, FIFO/zero-rate handling, queue/holding-area accounting, topology retirement, receipt mechanism keys, config validation, and test adequacy. Produce APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES; every finding must cite a concrete repo path and line range from the pinned commit and must distinguish FACT, INFERENCE, or UNVERIFIED. Do not modify code.
acceptance: Return an explicit verdict APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES.
Each finding is a concrete code path with line anchor and a falsifiable explanation.
No blocking or major issue is omitted from the open_items section.
requiredEvidence: Exact file paths and line references from the pinned commit
Specific tests or code paths that reproduce or rule out each suspected defect
